tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "What do you usually do on Sundays?"
B builds the answer from the tiles. The blue tile says make / do: choose the right verb and put it into the right form (made, does ...). Make = create something. Do = a task or an activity.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Swap cards and do it all again, faster.
